donor_snapshot_comparison.note: Raw98 and the retained IBD contain different donor snapshots at the same verified AN1/PTN000437926 ancestor. Both literal versions are preserved; target descent matches. This provenance difference is not treated as weak or circular evidence.

literal_Ensembl.qualification: Official Ensembl parent-gene and direct cross-references establish gene identity.
